library.title: Pipelines
library.intro: Turn a sequence of ideas into a repeatable image workflow. Run one picture or an entire collection.
library.emptyHint: Choose a template or build a workflow from scratch.

editor.label: Pipeline editor
editor.shortcutsDetail: Ctrl/⌘ Z · undo · Ctrl/⌘ S · save

settings.title: Pipeline settings
settings.privacy: Your pipeline is private. JSON exports contain settings and private picture references, without image bytes or credentials.

run.title: Run pipeline
run.help: Supply the inputs used by this workflow. Every batch picture gets an independent run through the same connected steps.
run.batchEmpty: One picture or a whole collection
run.batchLimit: Up to {count} images · Library, uploads or People
run.defaultHint: Choose pictures, or use the input’s default picture if one is set.
run.costHint: Exact costs appear after confirmation. Accepted runs continue in the background.
run.wakeUnavailable: Your run is saved, but processing could not be reached yet. It may still be starting after being idle. Refresh progress if it does not start.
run.wakeNotConfigured: Your run is saved, but background processing is not configured for this workspace. Ask an organization owner to check its setup.
run.issueMaskModel: {label}: choose a model that does not require a mask.
run.issueModelUnavailable: {label}: the selected image model is unavailable.
run.creditExhausted: Your available credit is used up. Ask an organization owner to add credit.
run.creditOutstanding: Your previous charges need to settle before another run can use your credit.

history.title: Saved runs
history.intro: Open any run to inspect each input, step and confirmed cost.
history.empty: Your first run will appear here.

confirm.deleteBody: Saved runs, image files and existing charges are preserved. The pipeline will be removed from your list.
confirm.discardBody: Your last saved version is preserved. Changes still in this tab will be discarded.

notices.modelsFailed: Image models could not load. Reopen the pipeline to refresh their availability.
notices.copied: {label} copied. Paste to add another copy.
notices.typeMismatch: Connect image to image, or text to text.
notices.cycle: That connection would create a loop. Choose a later step instead.
notices.edgeLimit: A pipeline can have up to {count} connections.
notices.imported: Imported as a new private draft. Picture references still require access in your account.

errors.queueFull: The queue is full. Wait for existing work to finish, then try again.
errors.unavailable: This pipeline or one of its pictures is no longer available to your account.
errors.conflict: This pipeline changed in another tab. Reload the saved version before continuing.
errors.loadList: Could not load your pipelines. Try again.
errors.invalidSave: Check the pipeline name, connections and node settings before saving.
errors.save: Could not save this pipeline. Your changes remain in this tab.
errors.invalidExport: Check the pipeline before exporting it.
errors.importTooLarge: Choose a pipeline JSON file smaller than 1 MB.
errors.importInvalid: This is not a valid pipeline export. Check its node settings and connections.
errors.start: Could not start the run. Retry uses the same request key so accepted work is not duplicated.
errors.refresh: Could not refresh this run. Background work continues; try checking again.
errors.cancel: Could not request cancellation. Refresh the run before trying again.
errors.retry: Could not retry these steps. Refresh the saved run before trying again.
errors.rerunBlocked: This job cannot be requeued yet. Refresh progress and wait for outstanding prices to settle before trying again.
errors.rerun: Could not rerun this job. Refresh progress before trying again; accepted work may already be queued.
errors.openRun: Could not open this saved run.

descriptions.imageInput: A picture supplied each time the pipeline runs.
descriptions.peopleInput: Reusable person pictures from your People or shared profiles.
descriptions.textInput: A prompt or value supplied for each run.
descriptions.staticImage: Reusable pictures from your Library or People.
descriptions.staticText: Keep a prompt or instruction in the pipeline.
descriptions.generateImage: Generate or edit pictures with the current image models.
descriptions.describeImage: Describe a picture and pass its text to another step.
descriptions.promptEnhancer: Turn a short idea into a detailed prompt.
descriptions.llm: Transform text with a custom instruction.
descriptions.removeBackground: Make a transparent cutout with BiRefNet on the CPU.
descriptions.upscale: Enlarge pictures by 2× or 4×, with optional AI detail.
descriptions.expand: Generate a larger scene around your picture.
descriptions.crop: Crop to exact dimensions and choose the focus position.
descriptions.translate: Translate the text in a picture while preserving its design.
descriptions.promptConcatenator: Join several text branches in connection order.
descriptions.output: Collect the pipeline results and choose their image format.
descriptions.stickyNote: Leave a note on the canvas for your future self.
